description:
Job Summary 

Position Summary: We are seeking a Production Engineer to support operations at our water chemical

treatment facility across two key areas: Production and Logistics. This role requires a hands-on

engineering professional who will optimize processes, ensure safety compliance, and drive continuous

improvement initiatives while managing both production operations and supply chain logistics.
 

 Key Characteristics: 
 Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills - The role requires conducting root cause analysis, investigating quality concerns and equipment non-conformances, performing supply chain optimization analysis, and continuously making decisions to improve process efficiencies. The engineer must be able to systematically identify issues, analyze complex data (like OEE metrics), and develop effective countermeasures.
 Excellent Communication and Training Abilities - The position involves networking with site, regional, and global functions, performing classroom instruction for operations teams, coordinating with vendors, and managing cross-functional relationships between production and logistics. The engineer must effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences and facilitate knowledge transfer.
 Strong Organizational and Project Management Skills - The role requires balancing multiple responsibilities across two locations (Production and Logistics), managing over 36 bulk storage tanks, coordinating scheduling for materials/packaging/shipments, identifying and executing CAPEX/OPEX projects, and maintaining documentation. The engineer must prioritize tasks effectively, manage timelines, and ensure compliance across various operational areas simultaneously.
 

 Duties & Responsibilities 

Support all Environmental, Health, and Safety programs, policies, and regulations
 Coordinate Management of Change (MOC) and Process Safety Management (PSM) operational opportunities
 Perform process engineering activities including heat/material transfer, mass balancing, and equipment performance assessments
 Conduct root cause analysis and implement appropriate countermeasures for operational issues
 Network with site, regional, and global functions to drive best practices
 Production Focus Areas:
 Manage bulk storage, production equipment, auxiliary systems, and utilities
 Track and analyze Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) data to identify quality concerns, yield losses, and equipment non-conformances
 Monitor daily production and quality rates to ensure optimal performance
 Identify, scope, and execute CAPEX and OPEX improvement projects
 Provide training and classroom instruction to operations teams
 Support production scheduling and maintain critical documentation
 Logistics Focus Areas:
 Balance daily administrative duties (25-40% of time) with field support activities
 Coordinate raw material scheduling and ensure adequate storage space availability
 Manage packaging schedules and prepare required documentation
 Oversee shipment scheduling and documentation preparation
 Conduct vendor management and maintain chemical organization per segregation/lean standards
 Perform supply chain analysis for optimization opportunities
 Manage over 36 bulk storage tanks and develop equipment handling procedures
 Conduct inventory accuracy assessments and ensure risk management compliance
 This dual-role position offers the opportunity to gain comprehensive understanding of both production

operations and logistics management while driving process improvements and maintaining the highest

safety and quality standards in water chemical treatment operations.

 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: 
 Process Engineering and Equipment Analysis - Proficiency in heat and material transfer calculations, mass balancing, equipment performance assessments, and process optimization. This includes understanding of chemical treatment processes, equipment design principles, and the ability to analyze and improve process efficiencies for both quality and productivity outcomes.
 Data Analysis and Performance Metrics Management - Expertise in tracking, analyzing, and interpreting Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) data, production rates, quality metrics, and yield loss analysis. This includes statistical analysis capabilities, trend identification, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvement strategies.
 Process Safety Management (PSM) and Regulatory Compliance - Knowledge of Management of Change (MOC) procedures, Environmental Health and Safety regulations, risk management protocols, and chemical handling/segregation standards. This includes understanding of bulk storage tank management, chemical compatibility requirements, and maintaining compliance documentation for water treatment facility operations.
 

 Education & Experience 

 (Required) 
 Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering
 Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred but not required
 Relevant certifications in Process Safety Management (PSM), Hazardous Materials Management, or Water Treatment Operations are advantageous
 Experience Requirements: 
 Minimum 3-5 years of experience in chemical processing, water treatment, or related industrial manufacturing environment
 Experience with process engineering principles including heat/material transfer, mass balance calculations, and equipment performance optimization
 Demonstrated experience with data analysis, OEE tracking, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma preferred)
 Experience in project management for CAPEX/OPEX initiatives
 Background in supply chain management, logistics coordination, or inventory management preferred
 Experience with regulatory compliance (EPA, OSHA, DOT) and safety management systems
 Hands-on experience with bulk storage systems, chemical handling, and production equipment operations
 Experience in training and mentoring operations personnel
 Knowledge of Management of Change (MOC) processes and Process Safety Management (PSM) principles preferred
 Proficient in SAP, ERP, or comparable systems for production and logistics management.
 Hands on experience with Siemens automation and control systems.
 Proven ability to champion safety initiatives and foster continuous improvement in workplace safety culture.
 Direct operational experience with connection assembly/disassembly, line clearing procedure, pump operations, manifold system management
 Field experience in safe chemical handling and transfer protocols.
 Advance computer skills including Google sheets, MS excel, and Tableau
 
 At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger

communities. We’re an organization that champions diversity and inclusion at every rung of the ladder

and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Because our people are our greatest assets, we

also offer competitive compensation and benefits that include:



● Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance Starting Day 1!

● Life Insurance

● Paid Time Off

● Paid Holidays

● Parental Leave

● 401(k) Plan - 3% default contribution plus matching!

● Flexible Spending & Health Saving Accounts

● AD&D Insurance

● Disability Insurance

● Tuition Reimbursement



Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this

posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable

law.
 

****Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not

sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity****
 

Veolia does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiting firms. All vendors must have a

current and fully executed MSA on file before submitting candidates. Any unsolicited resumes and

candidate profiles will be deemed the property of VWTS, and no fee will be due.
  
 
 As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.
